materials: Paper apparatus:U-magnetNpoleleft,Spoleright gives field left→right in the page. The active straight conductor runs perpendicular to the page,front-to-back,with flexible leads to a sensitive centre-zero galvanometer in a closed path;other leads held outside the strong gap as far as practicable. Movement is in the page plane. Compare stationary,parallel-to-field horizontal,perpendicular upward,and angled motion with the same speed,active length and field. Predict zero/nonzero relative effects and explain why a wire moving in an unspecified orientation is insufficient evidence. Reference:OpenStax Motional Emf,https://openstax.org/books/college-physics-2e/pages/23-3-motional-emf.

Conditional actual experiment:teacher provides a stable school U-magnet,straight conductor,flexible insulated connecting leads and sensitive centre-zero galvanometer,prechecks connections,zero,sensitivity and safe clear movement. No external power source or mains is connected to this induction circuit. Use GEM6 geometry and fixed lead polarity;draw the actual apparatus before testing. Teacher supervises small controlled movements without striking magnet/meter or pulling leads. Observe and record actual readings for (1)stationary between poles,(2)parallel to field,(3)vertical upward perpendicular to field,(4)angled in-plane motion at comparable speed. Include a return/reversed-motion trial and baseline;repeat observations. Record date,observer/role,field/conductor/movement directions,lead convention,qualitative deflection and uncertainties,including any undetectable result. Do not fabricate expected deflection. If equipment/approval/sensitivity is missing,use GEM8 supplied record and mark experiment not performed. This matches the source's four motion conditions;qualitative predictions are not performance evidence.

I1:four magnetisation and three qualified demagnetisation descriptions use the domain model;soft-iron retention is bounded. Field drawing has closed noncrossing loops,outside N→S. I2:stationary/parallel zero,vertical nonzero,angled smaller under equal conditions. Meter sign depends on wiring;field reversal flips it. Closed path is needed for current,not voltage existence. I3:explain qualitative flux-change factors and controls without exact multipliers. I4:generator/transformer energy/change and bell make-break distinction;written final proves no actual experiment or project. Outcome d requires separate observed GEM7 evidence.
